answer_1.quote: we use an LLM to generate abstractive 'evidence' from EHR

answer_4.quote: To assess the viability of clinicians using this model in practice, we collect in-depth annotations intended to simulate the real-world use of this technology.
answer_4.guideline: we ask for estimates of the likelihood ("unlikely", "somewhat likely", or "very likely") of each of the possible conditions... Then, we show the annotator the model predictions and ask if the predicted risk for the conditions aligns with intuition... the annotator notes the usefulness of the evidence with respect to each condition... and whether the annotator remembers seeing this piece of evidence.
